beats.line: This twig is moving all by itself. So... who's carrying it?
A whole team of tiny ants — and they don't use their eyes to find the way.
They follow an invisible trail of smell — a scent road left by the ant before.
And they're strong — a team can carry a crumb the size of a car!
No one's the boss — yet every single ant matters. Meet Marco the ant in Episode 3.
